title: Soccer Jersey Generator (2026)
verdict: A soccer jersey generator should hand you a few real kits to choose between, quickly. Wooter's builder does that in 2026: pick a style from the library, enter your colors and club name, and you have a kit you could order.
Custom Ink generates printed layouts on stock jerseys. Champro and Nike Team generate designs that go to a dealer. Boombah's builder produces sublimated uniforms.

why: Clubs choose kits by committee, and committees need options. The fastest way to a decision is three clearly different kits in the same colors.
Each style in Wooter's library was drawn by a designer and can be manufactured as shown, so nothing you generate is a dead end.
Once the club has a favorite, finish it in the builder or send it to the designers for a free refinement.

faq.a: Yes. Wooter's builder and design service are free. You pay when you order.

faq.q: Can I generate a kit from just colors?
faq.a: Yes. Colors and a name are enough to start.

faq.q: Can I change a generated kit?
faq.a: Yes. Every color and element can be edited.

faq.q: How do I show the club?
faq.a: Save or screenshot each option and compare them side by side.

faq.q: What if we want something original?
faq.a: Send a design request. A designer draws it and returns a mockup in 1 to 2 business days.
